frequency_question: How often do major contested federal rules successfully reach final publication within a short compressed window despite structural friction (APA notice-and-comment delays, office of information and regulatory affairs review)?
membership_rule: Includes rules designated as economically significant by executive agencies that underwent notice-and-comment rulemaking and faced high structural/litigation friction; excludes minor or purely internal agency guidance.

cases.name: EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal and Replacement
Public Charge Rule for Green Cards

coverage_note: 6 named; representative of high-salience administrative rules finalized under tight constraints.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture hidden rules abandoned prior to publication due to internal friction.
skeleton: Total major contested rules reaching final publication divided by total major contested rules initiated with sufficient time runway.
validity_reason: Base rate reflects administrative procedure durability which spans presidential terms until statutory APA changes occur.
